title: 2021 HMMT November Guts Problem 7
statement: Two unit squares \(S_{1}\) and \(S_{2}\) have horizontal and vertical sides. Let \(x\) be the minimum distance between a point in \(S_{1}\) and a point in \(S_{2}\), and let \(y\) be the maximum distance between a point in \(S_{1}\) and a point in \(S_{2}\). Given that \(x=5\), the difference between the maximum and minimum possible values for \(y\) can be written as \(a+b \sqrt{c}\), where \(a, b\), and \(c\) are integers and \(c\) is positive and square-free. Find \(100 a+10 b+c\).
